podcast.body: Produced by Luther Vandross, this album sealed Franklin's 1980s comeback, bringing in a new sound of synthesized funk and kicking up the tempo. The title track returned her to the top of the R&B chart for the first time in six years and brought her back into the pop top 40. "under Vandros' guidance, the album they produced titled Jump to It, Sealed Franklin's 80s comeback, kicked up the tempo, and brought in a new brand of synthesized funk."
